title: MPESB MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book and Teacher Recruitment Update
qualification: As per MP teacher eligibility / MSPSTET notification (D.El.Ed / B.Ed / TET as applicable)

applicationFee: As published in the official notification

1. Open the official MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book.
2. The online form started on 21/08/2026.
3. Check the official date-extension notice published on 04/09/2026 for the revised last date.

shortDescription: MPESB MSPSTET 2026 Eligibility Test for Primary and Secondary Teachers started on 21/08/2026. Download the official rule book and check the 04/09/2026 date-extension notice.
content:
The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has published the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book for Teachers for the Eligibility Test for teachers teaching Primary and Secondary classes.

The online form started on 21/08/2026. MPESB also published a date-extension notice on 04/09/2026; candidates should check that official notice for the revised last date.

What candidates should do

  1. Download and read the official rule book from the link below.
  2. Check the level-wise educational qualification, syllabus and examination pattern.
  3. Use the official MPESB or MPOnline portal for registration and fee payment.
  4. Keep the submitted form and confirmation page for future reference.
editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.

faqs.question: Where can I download the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book?
faqs.answer: Download the official rule book from the notification link on this page and confirm any later correction on https://esb.mp.gov.in.

faqs.question: What does the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book contain?
faqs.answer: It contains the teacher eligibility requirements, syllabus, examination pattern, application instructions and other conditions for the notified process.

faqs.question: What should I keep ready?
faqs.answer: Photo, signature, educational certificates, category certificate (if any) and valid photo ID
